purpose: Verify deterministic bilingual search coverage for all 121 MathBridge concepts and check that high-risk aliases do not create false mathematical or curriculum matches.

high_risk_checks.reason: Keeps the classroom term useful while retaining the underlying regrouping/place-value concept.
Does not treat borrowing language as the complete mathematical explanation.

high_risk_checks.expected: mean-average primary only when statistical context is clear; division-meaning remains a possible contextual alternative
percent-meaning neutral concept; China curriculum placement resolved separately under Statistics and Probability
simple-equations primary; equality, unknowns and expressions available as related concepts
circles with note that no dedicated pi concept exists in the taxonomy
bar-models representation/practice concept without national-frequency claim
no silent exact synonym mapping to bar-models without context

integrity_checks.rule: Search resolves a neutral mathematical concept before grade/jurisdiction.
Aliases do not assign China Grade/England Year/Common Core Grade.
A Chinese textbook term does not establish current PEP sequence placement.
Representation/method searches do not imply a national classroom norm.
Chinese and English aliases resolve to the same language-independent concept IDs.
Materially ambiguous aliases retain candidate/related-concept information instead of being silently collapsed.
